name: tabs
description: A row of tabs over their panels, showing one at a time when its module is loaded and all of them when it is not.

attributes.name: data-orientation
attributes.description: Whether the tab list runs along the top or down the side.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the selected tab and its edge.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between the list and the panels.

children.description: The tabs, in order, with a name of its own.
A button whose aria-controls names its panel.
A panel whose aria-labelledby names its tab.

tokens.name: --yeti-tabs-border
tokens.description: The line under or beside the list.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: Width of that line; the selected mark is twice it.

keyboard.action: Moves selection along a horizontal list.
Moves selection along a vertical list.
Selects the first or the last tab.
Leaves the list for the selected panel.

a11y.notes: Give the tablist a name with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Every tab is a button whose aria-controls names its panel, and every panel names its tab back with aria-labelledby; that pairing is what the module reads. With tabs.js loaded one tab is selected, the rest take tabindex="-1" for a roving focus, and the inactive panels are hidden. Without it nothing is hidden and every tab is focusable, which is plainer but never traps content.
